question: Janet’s ducks lay 16 eggs per day. She eats 3 for breakfast every morning and bakes muffins for her friends every day with 4. She sells the remainder at the farmers' market for $2 per egg. How much in dollars does she make every day?
A robe takes 2 bolts of blue fiber and half that much white fiber. How many bolts in total does it take to make 3 robes?
Josh decides to try flipping a house. He buys a house for $80,000 and puts in $50,000 in repairs. He sells it for $150,000. How much profit in dollars did he make?
James writes a 3-page letter to 2 different friends twice a week. How many pages does he write in a 5-week period?
Every day, Wendi feeds each of her 3 cats 2/3 of a cup of cat food. How many cups of cat food does she feed her cats in 6 days?
Kylar went to the store to buy glasses for his new apartment. One glass costs $5, but every second glass is half price. How much does he spend on 16 glasses?
Toulouse has twice as many sheep as Charleston. Charleston has 4 times as many sheep as Seattle. If Seattle has 20 sheep, how many sheep do Toulouse, Charleston, and Seattle have together?
Carla is downloading a 200 GB file. The download speed is 2 GB per minute. After 40 minutes, how many gigabytes are left to download?
John has 4 boxes of pencils. Each box contains 12 pencils. He gives 10 pencils to his sister and 8 pencils to his brother. How many pencils does John have left?
A bakery sells cupcakes for $3 each and cookies for $2 each. If Sarah buys 4 cupcakes and 6 cookies, how much money does she spend in total?
Liam runs 5 miles on Monday, 7 miles on Wednesday, and 8 miles on Friday. If he wants to run a total of 30 miles this week, how many miles must he run on Sunday?
A train travels at 60 miles per hour. How many miles does it travel in 3.5 hours?
Emily has $100. She spends $35 on groceries, $20 on gas, and $15 on a book. How much money does she have remaining?
A farmer has 15 cows and 25 chickens. How many legs do all the animals have in total?
Mark earns $15 per hour. If he works 8 hours a day for 5 days a week, what are his total weekly earnings?
A rectangle has a length of 14 cm and a width of 6 cm. What is its perimeter in cm?
A water tank holds 500 liters. A pipe fills it at 25 liters per minute. How many minutes does it take to fill the tank completely?
A library has 1,200 books. 350 books are checked out on Monday, and 150 are returned on Tuesday. How many books are currently in the library?
If a shirt costs $40 and is on sale for 25% off, what is the sale price of the shirt?
Tom has 3 times as many marbles as Jerry. If Jerry has 14 marbles, how many marbles do they have altogether?
A car uses 1 gallon of gas every 28 miles. How many gallons of gas are needed to drive 196 miles?
An orchard has 8 rows of apple trees with 12 trees in each row. If each tree yields 5 bushels of apples, how many bushels are produced in total?
David bought 3 notebooks for $4 each and 2 pens for $1.50 each. He paid with a $20 bill. How much change did he receive?
A recipe calls for 3 cups of flour to make 12 pancakes. How many cups of flour are needed to make 36 pancakes?
A cinema has 250 seats. For a movie screening, 80% of the tickets are sold. How many empty seats remain?
Leo is 4 times as old as his dog. If the dog is 3 years old, what will the sum of their ages be in 2 years?
A gardener plants 15 tulip bulbs per square meter. How many bulbs are needed for a garden bed measuring 4 meters by 3 meters?
A factory produces 450 toys per hour. How many toys does it produce during an 8-hour shift?
A pizza is cut into 8 equal slices. If Alex eats 2 slices and Ben eats 3 slices, what fraction of the pizza is left (in eighths, give numerator)?
A plane flies 1,800 miles in 3 hours. What is the average speed of the plane in miles per hour?
